en-US.name: RUNLU TWIST
en-US.subtitle: 20 riddles. Think differently.
en-US.promotionalText: Think beyond the obvious with 20 classic brain teasers, English and Chinese play, and progress saved on your iPhone.
en-US.description:
A familiar question. An unexpected answer. RUNLU TWIST brings you 20 curated classic brain teasers in English and Simplified Chinese.

Take your time, ask for a hint, then reveal the answer and discover why the question led you astray. Record whether you solved it before the reveal and revisit every puzzle after finishing.

• 20 complete bilingual puzzles, hints, answers and explanations
• Works offline with all game content included
• Local progress and language preference on your iPhone
• Exploration points: 10 without a hint, 5 with a hint
• Optional self-assessment, separate from exploration points
• Native result sharing and a fresh-start reset
• Light and dark appearance

No account, ads, analytics or in-app purchases. The riddles are curated classics, not claims of original RUNLU inventions. Points reward exploration and do not verify whether a guess was correct.
en-US.whatsNew: First release: 20 bilingual classic riddles, hints and explanations, local progress, exploration points and result sharing.

zh-Hans.name: RUNLU TWIST 润庐脑洞
zh-Hans.subtitle: 20道经典脑筋急转弯，中英双语
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 换个角度，答案就在眼前。20道经典脑洞题，中英切换、离线游玩，进度保存在你的iPhone。
zh-Hans.description:
熟悉的问题，意想不到的答案。RUNLU TWIST 精选20道经典脑筋急转弯，支持英文与简体中文。

先自己想一想，需要时查看提示，再揭晓答案和解析。你可以记录自己是否在揭晓前想对，完成后从头回顾。

• 20道完整双语题目、提示、答案与解析
• 所有游戏内容随应用打包，离线可玩
• 本机保存进度及语言偏好
• 无提示揭晓得10分，使用提示后揭晓得5分
• 自评与探索积分分别记录
• 原生成绩分享与重置进度
• 支持深色和浅色外观

无需账户，无广告、分析追踪或内购。题目选编自经典谜题，并非润庐原创。积分代表探索进度，不验证答案是否正确。

zh-Hans.whatsNew: 首次发布：20道中英双语经典脑洞题、提示与解析、本机存档、探索积分及成绩分享。
